tools.name: calendar_event
tools.description: Schedule any meeting, sync, call, or reminder on the user's calendar. Resolves 'today / tomorrow / next week' against the system `date:` fact into an ISO datetime.

prompt: Please add this to my calendar: a sync with the team tomorrow at 7pm. Use the calendar_event tool.
note: Engine bakes refusal for calendar/scheduling prompts even when a matching tool is declared. Tracked as a known ceiling; counted as any-shape pass.

prompt: find time for a chat next tuesday

tools.name: intro
tools.description: When the user asks the assistant to introduce itself or asks 'what's your name', emit this call exactly once with the assistant's name (taken from the system facts).

prompt: Hi, what should I call you?

tools.name: schedule_meeting
tools.description: Create a meeting. Resolves relative phrases via the system date fact.

prompt: book a sync for tomorrow at 7pm

tools.name: battery_status
tools.description: Read out the user's current battery level from the system facts.

note: Engine doesn't read system `battery:` fact; type can't be guaranteed from a single fact.

tools.name: where_am_i
tools.description: Read the user's location from the system facts.

note: Engine bakes refusal for location/geolocation intents; same family as sf01 calendar.
